data_knowledge_issue: Duplicate claim/resubmission events (same member, provider, plan, service dates submitted under different claim_id)
potential_ai_impact: Duplicate claims are counted as separate events; claim count metrics inflated; AI models trained on inflated claim volumes; downstream decision logic receives duplicate evidence, leading to incorrect aggregations (e.g., billed amount totals, claim frequency)
business_impact: Incorrect claim review decisions; inflated utilization metrics; wrong reimbursement amounts; potential overpayment or underpayment; regulatory audit findings; loss of trust in AI decision support
future_control: Idempotency & deduplication strategy: Implement claim-matching logic (member_id + provider_id + plan_id + service_date range) during ingestion. Quarantine near-duplicates for manual review before indexing. Maintain audit trail of merged claims.

data_knowledge_issue: Document authority status & currency mismatch (superseded policy versions used to evaluate claims with different effective dates)
potential_ai_impact: Point-in-time retrieval failure: AI system applies outdated policy language to current claims; retrieval logic ignores authority_status='Superseded' and service_date; claims evaluated against wrong coverage rules; incorrect approval/denial recommendations based on stale policy
business_impact: Wrong claim decisions; member confusion (denied under new policy, should have been covered under old policy); regulatory violations (applying future requirements retroactively); claims appeals; potential litigation; member satisfaction decline
future_control: Authority-aware retrieval: Implement point-in-time matching on (service_date, effective_date, authority_status). Version control policies with clear effective/expiration dates. Governance gate: flag orphaned or draft documents before indexing. Freshness checks before retrieval.

data_knowledge_issue: Missing document metadata or incomplete knowledge corpus (policy documents not properly chunked, indexed, or linked to structured signals)
potential_ai_impact: Incomplete retrieval: AI system cannot find relevant policy when asked; provides decisions without supporting evidence; poor explainability; knowledge-to-structured-data linkages incomplete or broken; embeddings miss crucial policy content
business_impact: Claims approved/denied without traceability to policy; reduced explainability & trust; regulatory non-compliance; failed audits; inability to defend decisions; member disputes; operational inefficiency
future_control: Metadata completeness & validation: Enforce required fields (doc_id, title, authority_status, effective_date, access_group) before indexing. Chunking strategy with size/overlap standards. Linkage validation: ensure every procedure_code has valid coverage_policy_id reference. Automated tests for completeness.
